title: New Rabbit Owner Information
description: It does not replace advice from a rabbit-savvy vet. If your rabbit stops eating, stops pooing, seems in pain or is suddenly unwell, contact a vet…
body:
<div class="wp-block-group alignfull">
<!--
RabbitCare.co.uk blog article block
Page: New Rabbit Owner Information
How to use in WordPress:
1) Edit the blog page/post.
2) Add a "Custom HTML" block.
3) Replace the old article content with everything below.

Notes:
- No custom header/nav or footer included.
- Internal links use root-relative URLs.
- Uses the same visual style as the RabbitCare homepage and article pages.
-->

<section class="rcnew-page alignfull" id="new-rabbit-owner-information">
  <style>
    :root {
      --rc-cream: #fff9ef;
      --rc-cream-2: #f6ead8;
      --rc-sage: #7f9b72;
      --rc-sage-dark: #4e6b45;
      --rc-moss: #2f4a2e;
      --rc-gold: #d7a64b;
      --rc-charcoal: #2d2d2b;
      --rc-muted: #6f6a61;
      --rc-danger: #9b3b2f;
      --rc-danger-soft: #fff0eb;
      --rc-shadow: 0 24px 70px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.16);
      --rc-radius-xl: 34px;
      --rc-max: 1180px;
      --rc-font-heading: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
      --rc-font-body: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
    }

    .rcnew-page,
    .rcnew-page * { box-sizing: border-box; }

    body,
    .wp-site-blocks,
    .entry-content,
    .wp-block-post-content,
    main { background: #fef4f0 !important; }

    body .wp-site-blocks,
    body .entry-content,
    body .wp-block-post-content,
    body main,
    body article,
    body .wp-block-group,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      gap: 0 !important;
      row-gap: 0 !important;
    }

    body .entry-header,
    body .page-header,
    body .wp-block-post-title,
    body h1.wp-block-post-title,
    body .wp-block-post-featured-image { display: none !important; }

    body .wp-site-blocks > * + *,
    body .entry-content > * + *,
    body .wp-block-post-content > * + * { margin-block-start: 0 !important; }

    body .wp-block-html,
    body .entry-content > .wp-block-html,
    body .wp-block-post-content > .wp-block-html {
      margin-top: 0 !important;
      margin-bottom: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
      padding-bottom: 0 !important;
    }

    .rcnew-page {
      position: relative;
      left: calc(50% + 20px);
      width: calc(100vw + 40px);
      max-width: none;
      margin: -120px 0 0 !important;
      padding: 0 !important;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      font-family: var(--rc-font-body);
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.18), transparent 32rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, var(--rc-cream) 0%, #fffdf8 46%, #fef4f0 100%);
      overflow-x: hidden;
      line-height: 1.68;
    }

    .rcnew-page a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
    .rcnew-page a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(215, 166, 75, 0.9); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 10px; }

    .rcnew-wrap { width: min(var(--rc-max), calc(100% - 34px)); margin: 0 auto; }
    .rcnew-narrow { width: min(920px, calc(100% - 34px)); margin: 0 auto; }

    .rcnew-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      color: var(--rc-sage-dark);
      font-size: 0.84rem;
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .rcnew-pill::before { content: "✦"; color: var(--rc-gold); }

    .rcnew-btns { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 14px; align-items: center; margin-top: 30px; }

    .rcnew-btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 52px;
      padding: 14px 22px;
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 900;
      transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease;
    }

    .rcnew-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); }
    .rcnew-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--rc-sage-dark), var(--rc-sage)); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(79, 112, 70, 0.26); }
    .rcnew-btn-secondary { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9); color: var(--rc-moss); border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.16); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10); }

    .rcnew-hero {
      padding: 0 0 42px;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 80% 20%, rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.18), transparent 28rem),
        linear-gradient(180deg, #fff9ef 0%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0) 100%);
    }

    .rcnew-hero-image-wrap { width: 100%; margin: 0; padding: 0; background: #fff9ef; overflow: hidden; }
    .rcnew-hero-cover { position: relative; width: 100%; margin-top: 0; }

    .rcnew-hero-cover::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.70), rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.30) 48%, rgba(31, 45, 27, 0.06)),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18), transparent 45%, rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.12));
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .rcnew-hero-image {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      object-fit: contain;
      object-position: center;
      background: #fff;
      animation: rcnewFadeIn 0.9s ease both;
    }

    .rcnew-hero-title-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      z-index: 2;
      left: max(24px, calc((100vw - var(--rc-max)) / 2));
      bottom: clamp(28px, 8vw, 96px);
      max-width: 760px;
      padding: clamp(20px, 4vw, 38px);
      color: #ffffff;
    }

    .rcnew-hero-title-overlay .rcnew-pill { color: #ffffff; text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35); }

    .rcnew-hero-title-overlay h1 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 7rem);
      line-height: 0.88;
      letter-spacing: -0.065em;
      color: #ffffff;
      text-wrap: balance;
      text-shadow: 0 5px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42);
    }

    .rcnew-hero-title-overlay p {
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0;
      color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.36);
    }

    .rcnew-hero-content { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 0.95fr; gap: 34px; align-items: center; padding-top: 44px; }
    .rcnew-breadcrumb { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 18px; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 800; }
    .rcnew-breadcrumb a { color: var(--rc-sage-dark); }

    .rcnew-intro-heading {
      margin: 12px 0 16px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.4rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rcnew-hero-subtitle { max-width: 720px; margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: clamp(1.08rem, 2vw, 1.28rem); }

    .rcnew-hero-card,
    .rcnew-side-card,
    .rcnew-panel,
    .rcnew-card,
    .rcnew-step,
    .rcnew-benefit,
    .rcnew-sign-card {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12);
      box-shadow: 0 16px 42px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.10);
    }

    .rcnew-hero-card { padding: 28px; border-radius: 38px; box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow); backdrop-filter: blur(18px); }
    .rcnew-hero-card h2 { margin: 0 0 14px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.35rem; line-height: 1.18; }
    .rcnew-hero-card ul { display: grid; gap: 12px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
    .rcnew-hero-card li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 32px 1fr; gap: 10px; align-items: start; color: var(--rc-muted); font-weight: 700; }
    .rcnew-hero-card li::before { content: "✓"; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14); color: var(--rc-sage-dark); font-weight: 900; }

    .rcnew-quickbar { position: relative; z-index: 4; margin-top: 26px; }
    .rcnew-quickbar-inner { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 14px; padding: 16px; border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88); border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12); box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow); backdrop-filter: blur(18px); }
    .rcnew-quick { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 62px 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 14px; min-height: 96px; padding: 18px; border-radius: 24px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff, #fff8eb); transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease; }
    .rcnew-quick:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(83, 61, 42, 0.14); }
    .rcnew-quick-icon { width: 62px; height: 62px; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 2.35rem; line-height: 1; }
    .rcnew-quick strong { display: block; color: var(--rc-moss); line-height: 1.15; font-size: 1.02rem; }
    .rcnew-quick span span { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.35; }

    .rcnew-section { width: 100%; padding: 72px 0; position: relative; }
    .rcnew-section-header { max-width: 780px; margin: 0 auto 32px; text-align: center; }

    .rcnew-section h2,
    .rcnew-final h2 {
      margin: 12px 0 12px;
      font-family: var(--rc-font-heading);
      font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 5vw, 4.6rem);
      line-height: 0.98;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      color: var(--rc-charcoal);
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .rcnew-section-header p { margin: 0 auto; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 1.08rem; max-width: 680px; }
    .rcnew-article-layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 320px; gap: 28px; align-items: start; }
    .rcnew-content { display: grid; gap: 24px; }

    .rcnew-panel { position: relative; padding: clamp(24px, 4vw, 38px); border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl); overflow: hidden; }
    .rcnew-panel::after { content: ""; position: absolute; width: 190px; height: 190px; right: -82px; top: -92px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.10); pointer-events: none; }
    .rcnew-panel > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    .rcnew-panel h2 { margin-top: 0; }
    .rcnew-panel h3 { margin: 0 0 10px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.45rem; line-height: 1.2; }
    .rcnew-panel p { margin: 0 0 16px; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 1.03rem; }
    .rcnew-panel p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

    .rcnew-list { display: grid; gap: 12px; margin: 22px 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
    .rcnew-list li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 38px 1fr; gap: 12px; align-items: start; padding: 15px; border-radius: 20px; background: rgba(255, 249, 239, 0.9); border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.10); color: var(--rc-muted); font-weight: 700; }
    .rcnew-list li::before { content: "✓"; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14); color: var(--rc-sage-dark); font-weight: 900; }

    .rcnew-sidebar { position: sticky; top: 22px; display: grid; gap: 18px; }
    .rcnew-side-card { padding: 22px; border-radius: 28px; }
    .rcnew-side-card h2 { margin: 0 0 14px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.18rem; line-height: 1.2; }
    .rcnew-side-card ul { display: grid; gap: 10px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
    .rcnew-side-card a { display: block; padding: 11px 12px; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff9ef; color: var(--rc-sage-dark); font-weight: 850; transition: transform 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; }
    .rcnew-side-card a:hover { transform: translateX(4px); background: #fff4d8; }

    .rcnew-note { padding: 20px; border-radius: 24px; background: #ffffff; border-left: 6px solid var(--rc-gold); color: var(--rc-muted); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.08); }
    .rcnew-note strong { color: var(--rc-moss); }

    .rcnew-image-split { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 0.95fr 1.05fr; gap: 30px; align-items: center; }
    .rcnew-image-card { position: relative; min-height: 430px; }
    .rcnew-image-card img { position: absolute; object-fit: cover; display: block; border: 10px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.82); box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow); transition: transform 0.35s ease; }
    .rcnew-image-card img:hover { transform: rotate(0deg) scale(1.03) !important; }
    .rcnew-img-main { width: 82%; height: 350px; left: 0; top: 20px; border-radius: 42px; transform: rotate(-2deg); }
    .rcnew-img-small { width: 54%; height: 230px; right: 0; bottom: 0; border-radius: 34px; transform: rotate(4deg); background: #fff9ef; }

    .rcnew-diet { background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0), rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.09), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)); }
    .rcnew-card-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 18px; margin-top: 28px; }
    .rcnew-card { padding: 24px; border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl); transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease; }
    .rcnew-card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 24px 58px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15); }
    .rcnew-card b { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 56px; height: 56px; margin-bottom: 18px; border-radius: 22px; background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14); color: var(--rc-sage-dark); font-size: 1.45rem; }
    .rcnew-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.18rem; line-height: 1.16; }
    .rcnew-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rcnew-warning { padding: 68px 0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 240, 235, 0.56), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)); }
    .rcnew-warning-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr; gap: 28px; align-items: center; padding: clamp(24px, 5vw, 44px); border-radius: 42px; background: #ffffff; border: 2px solid rgba(155, 59, 47, 0.16); box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow); }
    .rcnew-warning-card h2 { color: var(--rc-danger); }
    .rcnew-warning-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 1.06rem; }
    .rcnew-warning-list { display: grid; gap: 12px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
    .rcnew-warning-list li { padding: 18px; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--rc-danger-soft); color: #4a2823; font-weight: 850; }
    .rcnew-warning-list strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; color: var(--rc-danger); font-size: 1.05rem; }

    .rcnew-steps { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 18px; margin-top: 28px; }
    .rcnew-step { padding: 24px; border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl); }
    .rcnew-step b { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 48px; height: 48px; margin-bottom: 18px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.15); color: var(--rc-sage-dark); font-size: 1.15rem; }
    .rcnew-step h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.16rem; }
    .rcnew-step p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rcnew-benefits-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 18px; margin-top: 24px; }
    .rcnew-benefit { padding: 22px; border-radius: 26px; }
    .rcnew-benefit h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.15rem; }
    .rcnew-benefit p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rcnew-sign-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 18px; margin-top: 28px; }
    .rcnew-sign-card { padding: 24px; border-radius: var(--rc-radius-xl); text-align: center; transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease; }
    .rcnew-sign-card:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 0 24px 58px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15); }
    .rcnew-sign-card b { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 58px; height: 58px; margin: 0 auto 18px; border-radius: 22px; background: rgba(127, 155, 114, 0.14); color: var(--rc-sage-dark); font-size: 1.45rem; }
    .rcnew-sign-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--rc-moss); font-size: 1.08rem; }
    .rcnew-sign-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--rc-muted); }

    .rcnew-final { padding: 70px 0 42px; background: #fef4f0; }
    .rcnew-final-box { padding: clamp(28px, 5vw, 52px); border-radius: 46px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(28, 48, 27, 0.92), rgba(58, 84, 49, 0.86)), url("https://rabbitcare.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Rabbitcare-new-rabbit-information-2.png"); background-size: cover; background-position: center; color: #ffffff; box-shadow: var(--rc-shadow); overflow: hidden; }
    .rcnew-final-box .rcnew-pill,
    .rcnew-final-box h2,
    .rcnew-final-box p { color: #ffffff; text-shadow: 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35); }
    .rcnew-final-box p { max-width: 780px; margin: 0 0 16px; font-size: 1.08rem; }
    .rcnew-final-box .rcnew-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #2f4a2e; border: 2px solid #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22); text-shadow: none; }

    .rcnew-related { padding: 74px 0; background: #fff9ef; opacity: 1 !important; transform: none !important; animation: none !important; }
    .rcnew-related, .rcnew-related * { opacity: 1 !important; filter: none !important; text-shadow: none !important; }
    .rcnew-related .rcnew-section-header { padding: 30px; border-radius: 34px; background: #ffffff; border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.22); box-shadow: 0 20px 54px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.14); }
    .rcnew-related .rcnew-section-header .rcnew-pill { color: #4e6b45 !important; }
    .rcnew-related .rcnew-section-header h2 { color: #243320 !important; opacity: 1 !important; text-shadow: none !important; }
    .rcnew-related .rcnew-section-header p { color: #332d26 !important; opacity: 1 !important; text-shadow: none !important; font-weight: 650; }
    .rcnew-related-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 18px; margin-top: 28px; }
    .rcnew-related-card { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 92px 1fr; gap: 15px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 24px; background: #ffffff !important; border: 2px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.22); box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(64, 43, 28, 0.15); transition: transform 0.22s ease, background 0.22s ease; }
    .rcnew-related-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); background: #fff; }
    .rcnew-related-card img { width: 92px; height: 92px; max-width: 92px; max-height: 92px; border-radius: 20px; object-fit: cover; background: #f1eadf; }
    .rcnew-related-card h3 { margin: 4px 0 6px; color: #243320 !important; line-height: 1.15; font-size: 1.08rem; font-weight: 900; }
    .rcnew-related-card p { margin: 0; color: #332d26 !important; font-size: 0.92rem; line-height: 1.45; font-weight: 650; }

    .rcnew-disclaimer { padding: 0 0 42px; background: #fef4f0; }
    .rcnew-disclaimer p { max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 18px 20px; border-radius: 22px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72); color: var(--rc-muted); font-size: 0.95rem; text-align: center; border: 1px solid rgba(78, 107, 69, 0.12); }

    .rcnew-reveal { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px); animation: rcnewFadeUp 0.9s ease forwards; animation-timeline: view(); animation-range: entry 12% cover 30%; }
    @keyframes rcnewFadeIn { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.985); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } }
    @keyframes rcnewFadeUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(26px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .rcnew-page *, .rcnew-page *::before, .rcnew-page *::after { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; }
      .rcnew-reveal { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 980px) {
      .rcnew-page { left: 50%; width: 100vw; margin-top: -90px !important; transform: translateX(-50%); }
      .rcnew-wrap, .rcnew-narrow { width: min(100% - 28px, var(--rc-max)); }
      .rcnew-hero-content, .rcnew-article-layout, .rcnew-image-split, .rcnew-warning-card { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .rcnew-sidebar { position: static; order: -1; }
      .rcnew-quickbar-inner, .rcnew-card-grid, .rcnew-benefits-grid, .rcnew-sign-grid, .rcnew-related-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
      .rcnew-steps { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .rcnew-image-card { min-height: 420px; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .rcnew-page { left: 50%; width: 100vw; max-width: 100vw; margin-top: -90px !important; transform: translateX(-50%); overflow-x: hidden; }
      .rcnew-wrap, .rcnew-narrow { width: calc(100% - 24px); }
      .rcnew-hero { padding: 0 0 28px; }
      .rcnew-hero-title-overlay { left: 12px; right: 12px; bottom: 18px; padding: 18px; }
      .rcnew-hero-title-overlay h1 { font-size: clamp(2.45rem, 13vw, 4rem); line-height: 0.92; }
      .rcnew-hero-title-overlay p { font-size: 1rem; }
      .rcnew-hero-content { padding-top: 30px; gap: 22px; }
      .rcnew-quickbar-inner, .rcnew-card-grid, .rcnew-benefits-grid, .rcnew-sign-grid, .rcnew-related-grid, .rcnew-steps { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .rcnew-quickbar-inner { padding: 12px; border-radius: 24px; }
      .rcnew-quick { grid-template-columns: 54px 1fr; min-height: 76px; padding: 14px; border-radius: 18px; }

              Rabbits need plenty of space to move, stretch and explore. Many cages sold in pet stores are too small for rabbits.
            </p>

          <h2>A proper diet is essential</h2>
          <p>
            A healthy rabbit diet should be based mostly on hay, with fresh vegetables, small amounts of pellets and clean water.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="rcnew-card-grid">
          <article class="rcnew-card">
            <b>🌾</b>
            <h3>Hay: 80–90% of diet</h3>
            <p>Hay provides fibre and helps keep your rabbit’s teeth healthy.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcnew-card">
            <b>🥬</b>
            <h3>Fresh vegetables</h3>
            <p>Leafy greens such as romaine lettuce, parsley, basil and coriander are great choices.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcnew-card">
            <b>●</b>
            <h3>Rabbit pellets</h3>
            <p>Pellets should only be given in small amounts.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcnew-card">
            <b>💧</b>
            <h3>Fresh water</h3>
            <p>Clean water should always be available.</p>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>

        <div>
          <span class="rcnew-pill">Foods to avoid</span>
          <h2>Some human foods are unsafe for rabbits</h2>
          <p>
            Avoid giving rabbits processed foods, chocolate, bread or dairy products. Rabbits need a high-fibre diet built around hay, not human snacks.
          </p>
        </div>

        <ul class="rcnew-warning-list">
          <li><strong>Processed foods</strong> Avoid crisps, biscuits, sweets and other human snacks.</li>
          <li><strong>Chocolate</strong> Chocolate is not suitable for rabbits.</li>
          <li><strong>Bread</strong> Bread does not support a rabbit’s digestive needs.</li>
          <li><strong>Dairy products</strong> Rabbits should not be fed milk, cheese or yoghurt.</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </section>

          <h2>Many rabbits can learn to use a litter tray</h2>
          <p>
            Many people are surprised to learn that rabbits can be easily litter trained. Most rabbits learn quickly and prefer using a litter tray once they understand where it is.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="rcnew-steps">
          <article class="rcnew-step">
            <b>1</b>
            <h3>Choose their corner</h3>
            <p>Place a litter tray in the corner where your rabbit usually goes.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcnew-step">
            <b>2</b>
            <h3>Use rabbit-safe litter</h3>
            <p>Paper-based bedding is a useful rabbit-safe litter option.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcnew-step">
            <b>3</b>
            <h3>Add hay nearby</h3>
            <p>Add hay to the litter area to encourage your rabbit to use it.</p>
          </article>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

          <h2>Rabbits are very social animals</h2>
          <p>
            Rabbits are very social animals. In the wild, they live in groups and rely on companionship. Your rabbit will benefit from daily interaction with you, toys and enrichment, and time outside their enclosure.
          </p>
          <p>
            Many rabbits also enjoy living with another rabbit, though proper introductions are important. Bonding rabbits should be done carefully and calmly.
          </p>

          <ul class="rcnew-list">
            <li>Spend calm time with your rabbit every day.</li>
            <li>Allow safe time outside the enclosure.</li>
            <li>Provide toys, tunnels and activities.</li>
            <li>Research rabbit bonding carefully before introductions.</li>
          </ul>
        </div>
      </div>

            <p>Willow toys can encourage safe chewing and play.</p>

            <p>Safe chew toys help satisfy natural chewing behaviour.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcnew-benefit">
            <h3>Digging boxes</h3>
            <p>Boxes filled with paper or hay can provide natural digging enrichment.</p>
          </article>

            <h3>Hideouts</h3>
            <p>Hiding spaces help rabbits feel safe and secure.</p>
          </article>

          <article class="rcnew-benefit">
            <h3>Rotating toys</h3>
            <p>Changing toys regularly can keep enrichment interesting.</p>
          </article>

          <p>
            Regular health care is important for rabbits. Basic care includes brushing long-haired rabbits, checking nails, monitoring eating habits and watching droppings.
          </p>

        <ul class="rcnew-warning-list">
          <li><strong>Grooming</strong> Brush long-haired rabbits regularly to prevent matting.</li>
          <li><strong>Nails</strong> Check nails and trim them when needed.</li>
          <li><strong>Daily checks</strong> Monitor eating habits and droppings.</li>
          <li><strong>Vet care</strong> See a rabbit-savvy veterinarian for vaccinations and health checks.</li>
